verdict.rationale: Postman offers a documented, publicly-spec'd Postman API (with OpenAPI spec confirmed via probe) covering asset management, plus a CLI for running collections/CI and an official MCP server for agent access, indicating strong programmatic parity for many workflows. However, some UI-centric features (live collaboration sessions, workspace UI interactions, theming) lack clear API equivalents, and community evidence shows friction (forced cloud logins, telemetry, lock-in) that undercuts a fully open, API-first experience.
